description: The plot illustrates the training loss of various models trained on a 20M data size over a number of steps. The plot features broken axes to display different regions of the data. The x-axis, labeled "Step," is split into two linear segments: the left segment ranges from 0k to 80k with tick marks every 20k, and the right segment ranges from 420k to 440k with tick marks every 10k. The y-axis, labeled "Train Loss," is also split into two linear segments: the bottom segment ranges from 0.0 to just above 0.4 with tick marks at 0.0, 0.2, and 0.4, while the top segment ranges from 0.75 to 0.85 with tick marks at 0.75 and 0.85. Six solid lines without markers are plotted, all exhibiting high-frequency variance (noise), a sharp initial decline from the top y-axis segment near step 0, a gradual decrease across the 0k to 80k segment, and a relatively flat trend in the 420k to 440k segment. The red line (ChemBART Small 20M) starts above 0.75, declines to approximately 0.08 at 80k, and remains flat near 0.04 between 420k and 440k. The blue line, which has an obscured label in the legend, starts above 0.75, drops to roughly 0.07 at 80k, and stabilizes near 0.03 in the final segment. The green line (ChemBERTa Small 20M) starts above 0.75, decreases to about 0.1 at 80k, and levels off around 0.06 between 420k and 440k. The orange line (ChemBERTa Medium 20M) starts above 0.75, falls to approximately 0.08 at 80k, and flattens near 0.04 in the final segment. The purple line (ChemLLaMA Small 20M) starts above 0.75, declines to roughly 0.06 at 80k, and remains steady near 0.03 between 420k and 440k. Finally, the brown line (ChemLLaMA Medium 20M) starts above 0.75, drops to about 0.05 at 80k, and stabilizes near 0.02 to 0.03 in the 420k to 440k range.
